title: Customer Communications Specialist
jobDescription:
Role overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented Customer Communications specialist to support the Global Customer Experience team at Bazaarvoice. This role will act as an extension of our Center of Excellence (CoE), primarily focusing on the planning, configuration, and execution of Priority 3 and Priority 4 customer communications. The ideal candidate will take ownership of our operational calendar, maintain internal documentation, and serve as a liaison for our APAC stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities:
Campaign Execution: Build Gainsight journeys, configure targeting parameters, and design email content using Stripo for ready-to-execute Priority 3 and 4 campaigns (e.g., newsletters, webinars, events, and product updates).
Calendar Management: Continuously update the global customer communications calendar to ensure cross-functional visibility and prevent audience fatigue.
Governance & Documentation: Maintain and update our internal documents to ensure internal alignment and streamlined intake processes.
APAC Alignment: Meet regularly with APAC regional leads to intake requests, discuss specific regional needs, and ensure communications are deployed at optimal local times.
Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough content reviews and testing before deployment to maintain a high standard of professional, client-facing brand consistency.
 
Required Experience & Competencies:
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in Marketing Operations, Email Marketing, or Customer Marketing, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.
Mandatory Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with marketing automation or Customer Success platforms (Gainsight and Salesforce experience is highly preferred).
Design Tools: Familiarity with email design platforms (Stripo experience is a strong plus) and basic HTML/CSS for troubleshooting formatting.
Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple execution-ready campaigns simultaneously, update operational calendars, and maintain internal wikis (e.g., Confluence).
Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global cross-functional teams (specifically APAC stakeholders).
Attention to Detail: Exceptional quality assurance skills to ensure error-free targeting and formatting for audience-ready communications.

title: Senior HRIS Analyst
jobDescription:
The Human Resources function is responsible for providing human resources (HR) support to a major business unit or functional area. This includes any issues relating to talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, employee relations, training and development, and HR operations. The Analytics, Modeling, & Reporting area is responsible for analyzing and reporting on data sets for a particular area to evaluate, recommend and support the implementation of business strategies and operational processes. The Human Resources Information System (HRIS) and Reporting focus specializes in HRIS and Reporting maintenance and ongoing administration. Oversees the development and implementation of new or redesigned systems, reports, policies, and procedures. Manages relationships with vendors, and the development of training and documentation for system use and maintenance. This job family is in the professional level category and works independently with flexibility and authority over daily work priorities. Incumbents in this job level category may provide work direction to other employees but would not typically have the authority to discipline or reward other employees. There are different levels available that provide clarity on contribution expectations based on knowledge, application, problem solving, and collaboration. 
     
Job Description:
We are looking for a Senior HRIS Analyst to join our global HR Technology team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of our Workday ecosystem. You will partner closely with a global team of analysts and stakeholders to improve processes, resolve complex issues, and expand system capabilities that support our employees worldwide.Depending on your experience level, you will operate as either a high-level functional lead or a strong technical contributor, helping the team navigate the hire-to-retire lifecycle through smart technology solutions.
 
Key Responsibilities
* Team-Based Configuration: Collaborate with P&T(People & Talent) and other stakeholders to design, configure and test Workday enhancements across various modules. You will help translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Global Support: Provide high-level end-user support; help develop and maintain shared user procedures, guidelines, and system documentation.
* System Integrity: Contribute to the overall health of Workday by participating in business process audits and security reviews. Help the team ensure data compliance and offer fast resolution for high-impact issues.
* Feature Adoption: Join the team in analyzing, testing, and adopting new functionality from semi-annual Workday releases to keep our platform at the cutting edge. 
* Stakeholder Partnership: Build strong relationships with P&T partners and COEs to help advance Workday adoption and ensure a user-friendly experience for all employees.
* Shared Problem Solving: Research system problems and identify opportunities for improvement. You will seek opinions and feedback from the broader team to ensure suggested solutions are robust and global-ready.
* Reporting & Insights: Help the business make data-driven decisions by building and maintaining complex reports, calculated fields, and dashboards. 
 
Experience & Qualifications
Workday Expertise: 
* 6+ years of hands-on experience in Workday configuration. 
* We are looking for candidates with experience in one or more functional areas (e.g., Benefits, Payroll, Advanced Compensation, Absence, Talent, Security) but must have a strong HCM background.
* We do not currently have Workday Financials or Recruiting. 
* HR Process Knowledge:A strong understanding of global HR processes. 
* Collaborative Mindset: A proven ability to work effectively as part of a team in an environment with global members and overlapping time zones.
 
Technical Skills: 
* Proficiency with Workday Report Writer and Calculated Fields.
* Experience assisting with data loads and mass updates via EIBs.
* Experience with various HR system configuration outside of Workday a plus (ex. LMS, ATS, Engagement Survey, Rewards).
* Analytical Approach: A strong ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues alongside your peers.
* Adaptability: Ability to manage multiple tasks and contribute to team goals in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Why You’ll Love Working with Us?  
Work with cutting-edge technology in a collaborative, global team

title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer(Cloud Operations)
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Senior Offensive Security Engineer who is a "Jack of all trades, Master of some." You don’t need to be a world-class Red Teamer AND a Cloud Architect; rather, you need a solid foundation in offensive security, operational experience in cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) and the maturity to manage our external penetration testing and bug bounty programs. As a leader within our proactive security strategy, you will drive the identification of complex vulnerabilities through expert management of third-party tests and by leading sophisticated, in-depth internal assessments of our cloud infrastructure. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, tackling significant security challenges while mentoring others to influence strategy across the organization.
Shift Hours: This position will have working hours of 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST (Indian Standard Time) and will allow for a mixture of in-office and work from home.
What You'll Be Doing:
Lead Offensive Security Engagements: Own and execute complex, end-to-end internal penetration tests against Bazaarvoice's most critical applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments. You will simulate advanced, multi-stage attack scenarios to uncover systemic security weaknesses before they can be exploited.
Program and Tooling Enhancement: Take a lead role in defining the strategy for our offensive security capabilities. You will research, prototype, and implement new tools, techniques, and automation to mature our testing processes and keep pace with the evolving threat landscape.
Strategic Third-Party Penetration Test Management: Act as the primary technical lead for our third-party penetration testing program. You will not only manage the engagement lifecycle but also define the strategic direction of our testing roadmap, ensuring we partner with providers to target the highest-risk areas of our business.
Bug Bounty Program Leadership: Design, lead, and operate all aspects of our bug bounty program, serving as the technical interface for third-party researchers and coordinating internal responses to submitted vulnerability findings, ensuring clear communication and timely resolution.
Mentorship and Technical Leadership: Mentor junior team members and act as a security champion and trusted advisor to engineering teams. You will elevate the security knowledge across the organization by leading training sessions, developing secure coding guidelines, and providing expert consultation on secure architecture.
Threat Modeling: Proactively engage with development teams early in the SDLC to conduct threat modeling exercises, helping them build more secure products from the ground up.
Required Skills and Experience:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience with 10+ years of related experience.
7+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, with a strong background in penetration testing, red teaming, or application security.
Operational Cloud Expertise: 3-5 years of hands-on experience operating in, managing, or performing manual penetration tests of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), with a deep understanding of cloud-native attack vectors (e.g., IAM exploitation, container escapes, and serverless security).
Expert-level knowledge in managing the lifecycle of penetration testing engagements and a proven track record of driving remediation efforts in a complex, multi-team environment.
Deep and practical understanding of common and advanced vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10 and beyond) and the ability to architect solutions to remediate them at scale.
High proficiency in one or more scripting languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) for advanced tool development and automation of complex tasks.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
A proven history of mentorship and a passion for elevating the skills of those around you.

Desired Skills and Experience:
Advanced offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GPEN, GXPN, or equivalent.
Deep expertise in AWS cloud security operations and infrastructure-as-code security.
Experience building and maturing an offensive security program or function.
Demonstrated experience leading red team or purple team exercises.
Published security research, conference presentations, or active contributions to the open-source security community.
Experience in a Security Development Lifecycle (SDL) environment and a history of implementing DevSecOps principles. 
 
Why You’ll Love Working with Us?   
Work with cutting-edge tech in an innovative, collaborative environment.  
Competitive salary + good benefits (insurance, annual leave, bonuses, referral rewards, and more).  
We’reGreat Place to Work Certified (3 years in a row!).  
Hybrid work model (3 days in office – Prestige Tech Pacific, Kadubeesanahalli).  
   
Interview Process:  
Tech Round 1
Tech Round 2 
Hiring Manager Meeting: Team, values & culture check.  
Final Round: Chat with HR/Senior Leadership.  
 
  
Ready to take on the challenge? Apply now!

title: Staff Database Engineer
jobDescription:
Who we want:
Are you ready to combine your talent for crafting solid data systems and enthusiasm for cutting-edge technology to harness the power of data at Bazaarvoice?  We’re looking for a strong database engineer who thrives on building large-scale, robust, distributed data systems and pipelines, who understands the importance of good software engineering practices to get it done.  If you’re excited about shaping the future of data at Bazaarvoice, come join us.
 
How you will make an impact:
As a key member of the Data Operations team, you’ll be tasked with designing, building, and supporting large-scale, distributed data systems that drive our organization’s data infrastructure forward, and power our products and services. Your responsibilities will include managing RDS databases, developing data pipelines, optimizing data storage and retrieval processes, and ensuring the reliability and scalability of our data architecture. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements, implement solutions, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. You’ll also play a pivotal role in advocating for and implementing software engineering best practices to ensure the efficiency, maintainability, and robustness of our data systems. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and contribute to shaping the future of data-driven decision making within our organization.
 
What You’ll Do
Identify, analyze, and resolve complex performance and scalability issues
Deeply analyze execution plans, indexing strategies, concurrency, locking, and resource utilization
Design and implement durable performance improvements across queries, schemas, and workloads
Build automation and tooling to detect, diagnose, and remediate database performance issues
Partner with application and platform teams to improve database access patterns and system design
Establish, document, and enforce database performance best practices
Clearly explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences
 
Required Expertise
Candidates must demonstrate expert-level (“can teach a class”) knowledge in all the following:
Performance tuning and optimization
Transactional ( PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora etc.,) Analytical(Redshift, Iceberg etc.,) 
Query optimizers, execution plans, indexing, statistics, and transaction isolation
Designing and supporting database-backed APIs
Building automation and tooling to support database performance and reliability
Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
Leveraging AI to automatically identify bottlenecks
Cloud platforms: AWS, including managed database services
Performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and tuning in distributed systems
CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
Capacity planning, workload modeling, and cost optimization
 
What We’re Looking For
A proven track record of improving database performance at scale
A keen eye to spot when something isn’t right and the diligence to not stop until its resolved
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to mentor engineers and influence architecture and design decisions
Comfortable operating as a technical authority across teams
 
Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of data storage and streaming solutions, data architecture, analytics frameworks, governance protocols, and data quality standards.
Serve as subject matter expert in database performance, CDC, ETL, scalability, and security
Develop and enforce enterprise standards, policies, and procedures
Partner with senior leadership to align data architecture with business strategy
Lead major modernization, migration, or transformation projects
Mentor other technical staff and lead knowledge-sharing efforts
Evaluate technology trends and make strategic recommendations
 
Expertise & Knowledge:
Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and a minimum of 14 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with 8+ years of experience; or equivalent related work experience
Recognized expert in database design, architecture, and optimization
Demonstrated leadership in enterprise database strategy and execution
Experience with cloud-native and distributed database solutions
Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills
 
Why You’ll Love Working with Us?
- Work with cutting-edge tech in an innovative, collaborative environment.
- Competitive salary + good benefits (insurance, annual leave, bonuses, referral rewards, and more).
- We’re Great Place to Work Certified (4 years in a row!).
- Hybrid work model (3 days in office – Prestige Tech Pacific, Kadubeesanahalli).

title: Transactional Sales Representative
jobDescription:
Role Summary
As a Transactional Sales Representative, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue and ensuring customer satisfaction within our APAC market. You will manage the end-to-end sales cycle for inbound opportunities, process sampling campaign orders, and collaborate closely with our primarily oversees based sales team to build a healthy pipeline.
Because you will be joining a highly diverse, multicultural team, a core part of your success will involve demonstrating an exceptional level of multicultural fit, alongside mastering the Bazaarvoice Knowledge Base to serve as a trusted, knowledgeable resource for our regional clients.
Key Responsibilities
Qualifications & Requirements
 
 
Own the Sales Cycle: Qualify inbound leads and run the sales process to completion to ensure regional customer satisfaction.
Pipeline & Cross-Border Collaboration: Partner closely with the account team and oversees based sales counterparts to identify new business opportunities, build a robust sales pipeline, and boost transactional revenue.
Campaign Management: Efficiently process and manage incoming sales orders specifically for client sampling campaigns within the APAC region.
Consultative Selling: Analyze and comprehend unique, localized customer requirements to provide tailored product solutions.
Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert on the Bazaarvoice Knowledge Base (Program Basics) to effectively guide clients and provide insights on sampling programs.
Cross-Cultural Competence: Thrive within our multicultural internal ecosystem and demonstrate a high level of cultural agility when dealing with diverse clients and stakeholders across different time zones.
1–2 years of experience in sales, customer support, or account management (experience working with international clients or APAC markets is a major plus).
High Multicultural Fit: Proven ability to collaborate effectively, communicate clearly, and build strong relationships within a diverse, multicultural team environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with a knack for building trust across different cultures and regions.
Time-Zone Flexibility: Comfort and willingness to align working hours closely with the Australian sales team and APAC clients where necessary.
Highly self-motivated, organized, and capable of managing a sales workflow independently.
Proven ability to learn complex product information quickly and take initiative.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce software is a strong plus.
